result.instructions: Tools for Woodpecker, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my cold email campaigns are running, and how many replies has each one had?"; "Show me everyone who replied as interested in the last week."; "Add these three prospects to my Q1 outreach campaign.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Woodpecker data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run woodpecker_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run woodpecker_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run woodpecker_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. woodpecker_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List cold email campaigns with their status (RUNNING, DRAFT, EDITED, PAUSED, STOPPED, COMPLETED). Filter by status or ids. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v1/campaign_list.

tools.name: woodpecker_get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign with its detailed information and statistics (sent, opened, replied, bounced). Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v1/campaign_list?id={id}.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_prospects
tools.title: List prospects
tools.description: List prospects across the account with their global status (ACTIVE, BOUNCED, REPLIED, BLACKLIST, INVALID). Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v1/prospects.

interested.description: Interest level set in any of the campaigns the prospect is enrolled in.

diff.description: Activity after a timestamp, as activity>timestamp; activity is updated or last_opened (last_opened needs activity=OPENED). Example: updated>2026-11-01T00:00:00+00:00. The tool encodes the +.

page.description: Page number (1-based on prospect and inbox lists; 0-based on users).

sort.description: Column to order by (default: id ascending).

tools.name: woodpecker_list_campaign_prospects
tools.title: List prospects in a campaign
tools.description: List the prospects enrolled in one or more campaigns, with their status and replies inside those campaigns. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v1/prospects?campaigns_id=.

interested.description: Interest level set in any of the campaigns the prospect is enrolled in.

page.description: Page number (1-based on prospect and inbox lists; 0-based on users).

sort.description: Column to order by (default: id ascending).

tools.name: woodpecker_search_prospects
tools.title: Search prospects
tools.description: Find prospects by field, for example email=jane@acme.com or company=Acme. Set campaigns_details to also get the campaigns each prospect belongs to. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v1/prospects?search=.

page.description: Page number (1-based on prospect and inbox lists; 0-based on users).

tools.name: woodpecker_get_prospect_responses
tools.title: Get a prospect's replies
tools.description: Get the replies one prospect sent, optionally only for some campaigns. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/prospects/{prospect_id}/responses.

prospect_id.description: The prospect id (from woodpecker_list_prospects or woodpecker_search_prospects).

campaign_id.description: Comma-separated campaign ids to filter by.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_inbox_messages
tools.title: List inbox messages
tools.description: List replies in the unified inbox, filterable by campaign, mailbox, prospect status or interest, and read state. Paginated with cursors (max 50 per page). Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/inbox/messages.

prospect_status.description: Prospect's current status. Do not combine with interest or out_of_campaign.

prospect_interest_level.description: Prospect's interest level. Do not combine with prospect_status or out_of_campaign.

search_phrases.description: Comma-separated search phrases: up to 20 phrases, each at least 3 characters.

read.description: true = read only, false = unread only; omit for both.

out_of_campaign.description: YES = only messages not tied to a prospect.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_mailboxes
tools.title: List mailboxes
tools.description: List the connected sending mailboxes (SMTP and IMAP) with provider, daily limit and sent_today. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/mailboxes.

tools.name: woodpecker_get_mailbox
tools.title: Get a mailbox
tools.description: Get one mailbox by id: email, provider, daily limit, sent_today and sending delay. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/mailboxes/{id}.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_manual_tasks
tools.title: List manual tasks
tools.description: List manual tasks (follow-ups a person should do by hand, such as a call or LinkedIn step). Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/manual_tasks.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_users
tools.title: List account users
tools.description: List the users of the Woodpecker account with their role (admin or user). Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/users.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_blacklisted_domains
tools.title: List blacklisted domains
tools.description: List blacklisted domains (never contacted again). Use domain_filter to check specific domains; * is a wildcard. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/blacklist/domains.

domain_filter.description: Comma-separated domains to check, e.g. acme.com,woodpecker*.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_blacklisted_emails
tools.title: List blacklisted emails
tools.description: List blacklisted email addresses (never contacted again). Use email_filter to check specific addresses; * is a wildcard. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/blacklist/emails.

email_filter.description: Comma-separated emails to check, e.g. jane@acme.com.

tools.name: woodpecker_request_campaign_report
tools.title: Request a campaign report
tools.description: Start a per-campaign statistics report for a date range of up to 30 days ending today. Returns a hash: pass it to woodpecker_get_report. Woodpecker API: POST /rest/v2/reports/campaigns.

from.description: Start date, yyyy-mm-dd (at most 30 days back).

tools.name: woodpecker_get_report
tools.title: Get a report
tools.description: Fetch a report by the hash from woodpecker_request_campaign_report. The status field says READY when data is complete; call again later if it is not. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/reports/{hash}.

hash.description: The report hash returned by a report request.

tools.name: woodpecker_pause_campaign
tools.title: Pause a campaign
tools.description: Pause a running campaign so no more emails go out until it is run again. Reversible by the user in Woodpecker. Repeating the call on a paused campaign is safe. Woodpecker API: POST /rest/v2/campaigns/{id}/pause.

campaign_id.description: The campaign id to pause (from woodpecker_list_campaigns).

tools.name: woodpecker_add_prospects_to_campaign
tools.title: Add prospects to a campaign
tools.description: Add one or more prospects to a campaign's prospect list. A prospect whose account-wide status is not ACTIVE (for example REPLIED or BOUNCED) is not added. The campaign then emails them when it runs. Woodpecker API: POST /rest/v1/add_prospects_campaign.

campaign_id.description: The campaign to add prospects to.

send_after.description: Earliest contact time, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00+0100.

file_name.description: Import batch name, shown in the imported column.

tags.description: Tags starting with #, separated by spaces.

prospects.description: Prospects to add (1 to 500 per request).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Woodpecker
prompts.description: What you can do with Woodpecker here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_which_campaigns_are_running
prompts.title: Check which campaigns are running
prompts.description: List campaigns by status, such as RUNNING or PAUSED. Get one campaign for its sent, opened, replied and bounced counts.

prompts.name: read_replies_in_the_unified_inbox
prompts.title: Read replies in the unified inbox
prompts.description: List replies filtered by campaign, mailbox, prospect status, interest or read state. Get the replies of one prospect.

prompts.name: find_a_prospect_and_its_campaigns
prompts.title: Find a prospect and its campaigns
prompts.description: Search prospects by email address or company, with the campaigns each one belongs to. List the prospects enrolled in one or more campaigns.

prompts.name: build_a_statistics_report_for_up_to_30_days
prompts.title: Build a statistics report for up to 30 days
prompts.description: Request a per-campaign report for a date range of up to 30 days. Fetch the report by its hash once its status is READY.

prompts.name: check_mailbox_limits_and_blacklists
prompts.title: Check mailbox limits and blacklists
prompts.description: List the sending mailboxes with their daily limits and sent-today counts. Check whether a domain or email address is blacklisted.

prompts.name: pause_a_campaign_or_add_prospects_to_it
prompts.title: Pause a campaign or add prospects to it
prompts.description: Pause a running campaign, so no more emails go out until it runs again. Add 1 to 500 prospects to a campaign.
